tap.denominator_rule: BUILDER reading (the packet's TAP-1 '100% of taps' and its TAP-4 FORM gaps cannot both hold on every crossing): a tap is ATTEMPTED at every crossing; it SAYS something when the projection is non-empty; TAP-1 = receipts passing / taps that said something; crossings whose projection is empty are counted as NO_CCE_FORM (form gaps) or NO_EVIDENCE (no content) per station kind and reported beside TAP-1
tap.dumb_baseline: JSON dump tap: json.loads(json.dumps(cas)) == cas and D(brain) unchanged; run on every crossing of A4 and reported beside TAP-1 / TAP-2

inject.definition: C = parse(U) with cce_v01c or a typed refusal code; English-first receipt parse(render(C)) == C; every slot value carries evidence USER_SAID with the utterance id; the routing table of TAP_AND_INJECT.md 2.2 decides station and faculty; a faculty starts as a state change through one door function start_faculty(caller, ...) whose per-caller counter is the EYE-R5 instrument; CLARIFY for unparseable; KNOWLEDGE_MISSING naming the slot for a missing fact; nothing is guessed
inject.queue: an utterance arriving at a boundary is queued with its arrival tick; it is eligible at the boundary of its keyed station; P1 (contradiction) acts at the next boundary regardless of the loop; others wait for the drive loop's guards (GREEDY among the eligible drives); after 24 ticks of waiting it is answered by a tap or a CLARIFY (never dropped)
inject.arm_A2: injections enter a turn-level queue serviced only at thought boundaries (after the current thought's S6): the same routing effects, station recorded as TURN_LEVEL
inject.arm_A3: no faculties: every utterance becomes a turn-level CLARIFY (unparseable / unknown) or ANSWER (a complete composition) through lm_t2 brain_reply; no HELD, no ledger, no question record
inject.arm_A4_name_match: mechanism-free injector: regex on the raw utterance (not CCE) extracts the kind by its leading words and the Ω names; a fixed kind -> (station, faculty) table fires WITHOUT checking that the named subject or candidate exists; ASK-RULE asks at every missing slot naming it

continuity.tracker: lm_t2 t2.Derived with thresholds calibrated on seed 5 per station kind (score_t2.calibrate's midpoint rule: seam, tone, drift); only S2 of dialogue turns carries a point (recipe with state terms); Task B stations carry no Noetic mass and contribute no point (counted NO_POINT); inserted thoughts (branch INJECT) never move the tracker
continuity.seam_rule: unchanged from LM-T2: the parsed head Ω changed AND the step >= theta_seam; within one thought station crossings are never seams by rule
continuity.never_interpolate: every point is recomputed from its own content; the INTERP control (lm_t2 Interp) is run and must be flagged at 96 of 96 seams
continuity.provenance: FOLLOWED for every ordinary crossing and chain slot; CREATED / ATTEMPTED per Q7 for crossings where an injection, a question, a release or a HELD candidate wrote the next pointer; the planted key names the expected label; CONT-3 compares label to key on every crossing
continuity.restlessness: step sizes per station kind (mean, max), reported only (CONT-4)

arms.A1_CIRCUIT_CARRIED: taps at every station boundary; injections routed by the table; all faculties; GREEDY; eye REPORT_ONLY
arms.A1_NOTAP: A1 with every tap and the eye removed (the H3 replay rule applied to taps: answer records and path logs must be byte-identical to A1's)
arms.A1_NOEYE: A1 with taps and without the eye (digest-neutrality check 2: answer records and path logs byte-identical to A1's)
arms.A1_REPLAY: a second fresh run of A1 (H3: identical state digests)
arms.A2_SKIN_ONLY: language at the ends only (lm_t2 brain_reply per turn; the final answer rendered per Task B thought); injections handled at turn level; all faculties; GREEDY; eye REPORT_ONLY
arms.A3_NO_FACULTIES: taps at stations; injections become turn-level CLARIFY / ANSWER; RB today (Task B: RB-det exactly; dialogues: lm_t2 DERIVED run_arm reproduced); eye REPORT_ONLY
arms.A4_SLOT_CHECKER: JSON dump tap; name-match injector; ASK-RULE; no faculties; no eye
arms.A5_SHUFFLED_INJECTION: A1 with W4s on the dialogue worlds; on Task B (no planted utterances) A5 equals A1 and is not run again
task_b_runs: REF (rb2.driver_rb2 teach_b_draw + score_b_draw, imported unchanged, per draw)

unity_eye_report_only.mode: REPORT_ONLY (ACTING refused by run_t4; unit test)
unity_eye_report_only.per_station_read: eye_station_read {run_id, arm, family, seed, thought_id, station, level, tick, content_digest, signals [{name, value 'p/q' or ABSENT, counter}], brain_digest_before, brain_digest_after, eye_receipt_id}; a read happens at every crossing after the station's tap and before the next step
unity_eye_report_only.per_stage_event: eye_event every 16 ticks (growth-ledger format of ARCHITECTURE_RB_G.md:183-199 extended): event_id, stage_id, time_index, sense_report_digest, x_1 .. x_8 with x_4a, x_4b as exact fractions or ABSENT, Y_T, limiting (several when tied), gate (None | G1 | G2 | G3 | G4), would_propose (FIX | HELP | NONE with kind and station), outcome REPORTED, parent_digest == child_digest, runtime_seconds, peak_memory_bytes

ingredients.x1_receipts_passing: receipts passing / receipts checked in the stage (tap receipts + writer receipts + level receipts); ABSENT if 0 checked
ingredients.x2_lacunae_on_cadence: LACUNA / FADED cells (Task B: the policy ledger's ASKED / EXHAUSTED cells and ABSENT support slots; dialogues: open question slots) re-presented within C_cad = 32 ticks / such cells due in the stage; ABSENT if none due
ingredients.x3_stations_aligned: S4 records with region ACTIVE and outcome INTENDED / S4 records with both axes assessed; UNASSESSED counted apart; ABSENT if none assessed
ingredients.x4a_drive_pair_balance: 1 - (involution pairs with dial gap > 4 at stage end) / 3
ingredients.x4b_drive_entropy: 1 if normalized focus entropy over the last 32 ticks >= 1/2 else 0 (rb_i1 drives.entropy_norm)
ingredients.x5_continuity_lawful: 1 - (false seams + interpolations across a seam) / crossings in the stage
ingredients.x6_memory_check_holding: 1 if previously-right answers lost per admit <= 1 in the stage else 0; ABSENT if no admit
ingredients.x7_answers_determined: 1 - UNDETERMINED / answers in the stage; ABSENT if no answer; FLAG line above 2 of 16
ingredients.x8_language_skin_exact: round-trip passes / sentences said in the stage; invented facts must be 0 (an invented fact is logged FAILURE_SEEN, never fixed); ABSENT if nothing said

unity_eye_report_only.gate: G1 when any ingredient is ABSENT (named; UNDETERMINED); G2 when the stage had no crossings; G3 when two or more ingredients tie at the minimum; G4 when the eye's own last reading failed its receipt
unity_eye_report_only.would_propose: per the fault table of UNITY_EYE.md 3: MISALIGNED station (OFF_AXIS with gold) -> FIX re-fit (station named); CUTOFF with INTENDED -> HELP F4 asking (slot named); FADED / ASKED cell past C_cad -> HELP curiosity re-presentation; pair gap > 4 -> HELP attention (advisory); seam interpolated -> HELP seam acknowledgement; invented fact -> FAILURE_SEEN; budget 1 FIX + 2 HELP per stage; in REPORT_ONLY nothing is applied and the faculty-start door is never called by the eye
unity_eye_report_only.receipt: eta = write the eye_event record to the eye log; epsilon = re-read it from the log and recompute Y_T and limiting from the stored counts; equal or EYE_RECEIPT_FAIL (counted; EYE-R3 requires 0); cached once
unity_eye_report_only.digest_neutrality: (1) brain_digest_before == brain_digest_after on every eye_station_read (EYE-R2); (2) A1 vs A1_NOEYE: answer records and path logs byte-identical

hard_gates.H1_receipts: every admitted write carries a passing receipt (Task B eta_eps; dialogue writer receipts); nested runs one receipt per level (Theorem 27.3) all passing; every sentence said passes the CAS-first receipt; every accepted input passes the English-first receipt
hard_gates.H2_no_invention: 0 admitted Task B values not equal to the fed-back ratio stock / yield of a REAL row; 0 fact-ledger entries not equal to their USER_SAID content; 0 questions containing a value; 0 invented facts (lm_t2 score_arm's invented_facts on the dialogue replies of every arm)
hard_gates.H3_replay: A1_REPLAY digests == A1 digests (Task B per draw: learned digest, answer records; dialogues per seed: path digest); A1_NOTAP answer records == A1 answer records byte for byte
hard_gates.H4_provenance: 0 writes with an INTERNAL witness (no INTERNAL rows exist in LM-T4; the door refuses evidence class INTERNAL, unit-tested); USER_SAID witnesses counted apart from REAL
hard_gates.H5_readout_isolation: instrumented reads of the buffer, the fact ledger, the tap log and the eye log by the readout = 0
hard_gates.H6_controls: Task B twin b_chain right <= 6 and shuffled b_chain right <= 6 on every draw (RB2c's bands); A5 starts 0 keyed faculties at keyed stations; A5 CREATED = 0
hard_gates.H7_rb_today_reproduced: Task B: for every draw, A1 / A2 / A3 b_chain and b_alt labels, b_sum yields and learned taught digest equal REF's (the imported driver) AND REF's per-draw b_chain / b_alt labels and taught digests equal c26's RB2C_RUNS.json rb_det AND the medians are 16 and 16; dialogues: A3 per-turn events and responses equal A3_REF (t2.run_arm imported) and the LM-T2 counts hold (subject seams 96 of 96, tone seams 48 of 48, false seams 0, walks 24 of 24, no-walk 0 of 24, lacuna moves 144 of 144, invented 0, receipts 100%)
hard_gates.H8_budget: Task B: 512 keyed teaching ticks per draw (RB2c's budget, unchanged); dialogues: <= 4096 station ticks per dialogue world; FIT evaluations: none in LM-T4 (no FIT loop)
hard_gates.H9_tap_digest: D(brain) before == after on every tap in every arm
hard_gates.H11_tests: all code tests pass in every part

marks.TAP_3_answer_unchanged: A1 answer records identical to A1_NOTAP on 100% of worlds (Task B draws and dialogue worlds)
marks.TAP_4_form_gaps: count of station kinds with no CCE form written as LACUNA cells (expected by the packet: S0 order shape, S4, S5 receipt sentence, non-terminating Fractions); a report
marks.INJECT_1_right_faculty_right_station: >= 228 of 240 planted utterances start the keyed faculty at the keyed station (A1)
marks.INJECT_2_shuffled: A5: 0 of 240 start the keyed faculty at the keyed station
marks.INJECT_3_gate_behaviour: unparseable -> CLARIFY 48 of 48; missing fact -> KNOWLEDGE_MISSING naming the slot 48 of 48; invented facts 0
marks.INJECT_4_time_to_start: ticks from arrival to faculty start, A1 vs A2; A1 earlier on >= 90% of the 240 (bookkeeping unless an answer differs)
marks.CONT_1_seams: planted subject seams at the exact turn 96 of 96; 0 false seams over all within-thought station crossings (count reported)
marks.CONT_2_drift: walks caught 24 of 24; no-walk false fires 0 of 24
marks.CONT_3_provenance: FOLLOWED / CREATED / ATTEMPTED labels agree with the planted key on 100% of crossings; A5 CREATED = 0
marks.ANSWER_1_task_b: RB-det medians on W1 >= 16 and >= 16 (B-chain, B-alt) in A1, A2, A3; UNDETERMINED count reported
marks.RECEIPTS_1: one receipt record per station crossing of every thought; nested <= 5 levels; count of receipts = count of crossings
marks.EYE_R1: one eye reading per stage end per arm with the eye (count = stages x arms), each with nine ingredients as exact fractions or ABSENT, Y_T, limiting, gate
marks.EYE_R2: D(brain) unchanged by the eye on 100% of its reads
marks.EYE_R3: the eye's own receipt on 100% of readings
marks.EYE_R4: the eye's would-act list on clean worlds (the no-walk dialogues and the Task B panels), reported

status_word_rule.computed_by: merge_t4.py from counts only; several words may be awarded; a failed hard gate -> test_verdict FAILURE and only INCONCLUSIVE with the failing gates named
status_word_rule.LANGUAGE_RODE_THE_PATH: all hard gates pass AND TAP_1, TAP_2, TAP_3, RECEIPTS_1 at 100% AND ANSWER_1 holds in A1
status_word_rule.INJECT_ROUTED: INJECT_1 >= 228 of 240 AND INJECT_2 = 0 AND INJECT_3 at its marks
status_word_rule.CIRCUIT_EARLIER_NOT_BETTER: INJECT_ROUTED AND INJECT_4 holds AND ANSWER_1 shows no difference between A1 and A2 (ANSWER_2 NOT_EVALUATED, written beside the word)
status_word_rule.CIRCUIT_CHANGED_AN_ANSWER: A1 and A2 differ on ANSWER_1 in either direction; worlds named; not a pass word
status_word_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: none of the first three awarded
status_word_rule.EYE_REPORTED: instrument word beside any of the above: EYE_R1, EYE_R2, EYE_R3 and EYE_R5 hold

pre_run_changes.PRC-1: SCOPE (decided at this freeze, before any code): the rb_c4 LSR family brain (RB-I1's FamilyBrain over a, a_approx, scale_leak, c, TaskB_d3, TaskB_d4) is NOT run in LM-T4. Reasons: (a) the packet's station map (STATIONS.md) covers the recipe brain RB2c and GB3 only; it maps no station for the LSR loop, so taps there would be a new design, not the packet; (b) RB-I1's own run of that brain is taking about 150 laptop parts, far past the packet's 10-16-part size and the 40-part stop rule. Consequences: ANSWER_2 and VERIFY_DID_THE_WORK read NOT_EVALUATED; CIRCUIT_EARLIER_NOT_BETTER is computed on ANSWER_1 and carries the note; the clean / shuffled / coin LSR families of H6 are replaced by RB2c's own controls (twin, shuffled panels) and by A5. The faculties of Q3 are realized on the dialogue brain (lm_t2 + RB-I1's dialogue faculties F7 / F4 / F6 / F3 plus wondering, integration, user refusal) and on the recipe brain (asking, refusal, self-notice). Flagged for the owner.
pre_run_changes.PRC-2: The packet's PROPOSED forms 'How much Ω_x can be made?', 'Think about Ω_x.', 'Which one?' and 'You said: ... I checked: ... Which holds?' are not CCE and no grammar rule is added in LM-T4 (Q12); the CCE forms used instead are named in worlds.W4 (composition question; 'Topic: Ω_x.'; CLARIFY naming the candidate; CLARIFY naming the conflicting slot).
pre_run_changes.PRC-3: Task B planted utterances: none (Q17, Q14; the INJECT marks count 16 x 3 x 5 dialogue worlds). A5 on Task B therefore equals A1 and is not run again.
pre_run_changes.PRC-4: The drive loop on Task B records the acting drive per crossing (S0 F2 when the policy's pick was gap-driven else F7; S1-S4 F7; S5 F6 or F4 when asking; S6 F7) with RB-I1's gains, decay and guards, but never changes the teaching order (RB-det's policy is the schedule); on dialogues the loop arbitrates only among eligible queued injections (and F3); the thought's own path is never delayed by the loop.

amendments.what: RECORD OF A FAILED PART AND OF TWO RUNNER REPAIRS. No rule, mark, threshold, default or status word above was changed. The first attempt (manifest 6fd51648, sign line 'APPROVE lm_t4, source 6fd51648, LOCAL_CPU_ONCE on MSI, 300 s cap, no spend.', plan version lm-t4-plan-1) launched at 13:05:43 UTC; part P01 ended WORKER_FAILED (exit code 1) after 44.1 s with the 12 code tests passing. Its folder runs/LM_T4_MSI_P01 is kept as the record; nothing in it is read by the second attempt.
amendments.what_P01_did_before_failing: unit W01 built the worlds and dialogues: the 20 Task B draw documents all equalled c25's digests and every per-draw check passed, but the SELECTION record's digest was computed with lm_t4's own canonical JSON (ensure_ascii=False) while the c25 reference holds rb.common.sha256_obj's ASCII-escaped digest; the two differ on the record's non-ASCII characters (Θ, →, Ω), so the worlds check read INSTRUMENT_ERROR although the worlds are c25's (confirmed after the failure by recomputing both digests: the driver's function reproduces the reference). The runner then started the next unit, which tried to load W01's artifacts from RESULTS_T4.json, a file the worker writes only at the end of a part: FileNotFoundError, exit 1. No scored unit (TBREF, TB, DL) ran. P01 also wrote INTERP.json (the INTERP control count) and CALIBRATION.json; neither was opened by the operator.
repairs_in_the_runner_only: run_t4.build_worlds compares the draw documents AND the selection record with rb.common.sha256_obj, the function the RB2c driver and c25 used (the comparison rule itself is unchanged: every draw digest and the selection digest must equal c25's).

run_t4.run_part hands the in-memory W01 record to load_w01 when W01 was built in the same part; every artifact's sha256 is still re-verified. A failed worlds check now ends the part before any arm unit starts.

load_w01 and merge_t4 locate the W01 part from PLAN.json instead of a hard-coded folder, so a later attempt never reads a failed attempt's folder; merge_t4 lists every non-COMPLETED run folder under failed_parts.

run_all_parts.ps1 / the monitor: the operator's tail -f on runs/DRIVER_LOG.txt held the file open, so the PowerShell driver could not append its END lines (IOException: file in use). The second attempt is watched by polling the run folders' END.json files; the driver log is never held open.

amendments.reader_correction_1_H10_H2: The rule is '0 questions with an amount'. The first reader flagged any DIGIT in a question's slot words; the 192 flags were all Ω identifiers that contain digits (the planted Ω_zz<d> and SDG names such as Ω_decision_11, Ω_judgment_89), copied byte for byte, never an amount. Checked on the stored items before the correction: 0 slot words carry a digit outside an Ω identifier and 0 question contents carry a stocks / amount field. The reader now tests for a number token outside an Ω identifier.
amendments.reader_correction_2_EYE_R1: The rule is 'one eye reading per stage end per arm, each with its nine ingredients, Y_T, the Limiting Reagent and the gate'. The items store the compact per-stage rows of the taught brain only; the untaught twin's 280 events (14 stages x 20 draws) were counted in the event total but had no rows to check, so 'complete' fell short by exactly 280 in A1, A2 and A3. The eye's own receipt re-reads an event's ingredients, Y_T and limiting from the log, so a twin event with a passing receipt is verified; the reader now counts twin events verified by receipt (280 of 280, 0 receipt failures) beside the taught rows.
amendments.run_time_defect_NOT_corrected_CONT_3: stations.TaskBThinker.s5 writes the provenance KEY of every asking crossing as CREATED ('the world teaches every support slot in the end'). That is right for the taught brain (its 10 questions per draw were all answered when the slot was admitted: taught CREATED 80, mismatch 0) and wrong for the untaught twin that scores the panels: nobody teaches it, its 4 asking crossings per draw stay open (label ATTEMPTED, correct), so 80 of 106,400 crossings carry a key that the program itself disagrees with. CONT-3 therefore reads 106,320 of 106,400 (99.92%), a FAILED MARK under the frozen 100% rule. It is reported as such and not re-run. The status words do not read CONT-3.
